dispute_ticket.description: The driver threatened to lock me in when I asked to get out. I felt unsafe for the whole ride.
dispute_ticket.driver_statement: The rider was drunk and tried to open the door at the lights on Clemenceau Avenue. I told her to sit down for her own safety and did not stop until the destination.

Sit down or I lock the doors.
